name: Logger offline
condition: no record received for 15 min
note: Also the sign of a power cut at the panel (no UPS for the trial). Clears when records arrive again

name: Power interruption
condition: logger restarted after a power loss (boot = poweron or brownout); the gap before it is the outage
note: Logged with the outage start and end from the gap in the records

name: Meter not answering
condition: no good meter read in a whole minute (4 Modbus failures)
note: Wiring or meter address problem; or the meter lost its supply

name: Phase lost
condition: lowest 15 s phase voltage L-N below 100 V
note: Clears when every phase is above 180 V

name: Undervoltage
condition: a phase voltage L-N (1-min mean) below 207 V for 5 min
note: 230 V nominal -10% (SPLN); confirm against the PLN supply

name: Overvoltage
condition: a phase voltage L-N (1-min mean) above 242 V for 5 min
note: 230 V nominal +5% (SPLN); confirm against the PLN supply

name: Frequency out of range
condition: frequency min or max more than 0.5 Hz from 50 Hz
note: Usually means the genset is supplying

name: High demand
condition: highest kVA in the minute above 90 % of the contracted kVA for 5 min
note: Needs contracted_kva in site.json; off until it is set

name: Low power factor
condition: power factor (1-min mean) below 0.85 for 15 min
note: PLN bills excess kVArh below 0.85. Ignored below 1 kW of load

name: Current imbalance
condition: largest phase current deviation from the mean above 20 % for 15 min
note: Ignored when the mean current is below 5 A

name: Electrical room hot
condition: electrical room temperature above 35 C for 10 min

name: Electrical room very hot
condition: electrical room temperature above 40 C for 5 min

name: Electrical room humid
condition: electrical room humidity above 80 % for 60 min
note: Condensation risk

name: Temp/RH sensor fault
condition: no valid reading of a sensor in three 5-minute windows in a row (err in the record)
note: Wiring or failed sensor

name: SD card error
condition: records come from the RAM queue (SD card failing)
note: Data is still sent while online but not kept locally

name: Backlog growing
condition: oldest unsent record older than 60 min
note: Logger online but uploads failing

name: Weak WiFi
condition: WiFi signal below -80 dBm for 60 min

name: Clock wrong
condition: logger clock more than 2 min away from the server clock
note: Checked on the live snapshots; the records would carry the wrong times

name: Energy counter went backwards
condition: cumulative kWh lower than the previous record
note: Meter reset or wrong register

name: Push to OED failing
condition: no successful push to OED for 30 min
note: Not built yet: enable when the push to OED exists

name: Sensors disagree
condition: difference between TH1 and TH2 temperature above 5 C for 30 min
note: Not used at adab: TH2 is outdoors. Keep for sites with both sensors in one room

name: Outdoor very hot
condition: outdoor temperature above 36 C for 30 min
note: Above the usual daytime range of the WITA zone (about 22 to 34 C)

name: Condensation risk in the electrical room
condition: electrical room temperature (TH1) less than 2 C above the outdoor dew point (TH2) for 30 min
note: Humid outdoor air entering a cooler room condenses on cold surfaces and switchgear

name: Electrical room much warmer than outdoors
condition: electrical room temperature above outdoor temperature by more than 8 C for 30 min
note: Failed ventilation or cooling of the panel room. Set TH1's offset in the settings first, then tune this limit after the first week

name: Outdoor sensor wet or stuck
condition: outdoor humidity at 99 % RH or more for 24 h
note: Short spells at 100 % after rain are normal; a full day means a wet or failing sensor

name: Voltage dip
condition: a 15 s phase voltage sample below 207 V (-10 %)
note: Counts dips for the power quality review. A 15 s sample catches dips that last, not every short sag

name: Voltage swell
condition: a 15 s phase voltage sample above 253 V (+10 %)
note: For the power quality review

name: Voltage unbalance
condition: largest phase voltage deviation from the mean above 2 % for 10 min
note: 2 % is the EN 50160 limit; above it motors and pumps run hot

name: Phase current near the rating
condition: highest 15 s phase current above 90 % of the rated current for 5 min
note: Needs rated_a in site.json (main breaker or CT rating); off until it is set

name: Negative power on a phase
condition: a phase active power below -0.5 kW for 5 min
note: A CT fitted backwards or on the wrong phase (commissioning check), or power exported

name: Energy counter not moving
condition: kWh counter unchanged for 30 min while the load is above 1 kW
note: Wrong energy register or scale

name: Mains lost (logger on UPS)
condition: grid supply lost while the logger runs on its UPS
note: Needs the UPS and a mains-sense signal: enable when the UPS is installed

name: Logger crash restart
condition: logger restarted by its watchdog or after a crash (boot = panic or a watchdog)
note: Logged with the reason; repeated crashes raise A34

name: Frequent restarts
condition: 3 or more unplanned restarts within 24 h
note: Unplanned = power loss, brownout, crash, watchdog. The daily reboot and remote updates do not count

name: Firmware updated
condition: the logger started with another firmware version (remote update or flashed by hand)
note: Logged with the old and new version, from the first record after the boot (boot = reason@version)

name: Firmware update rolled back
condition: a new firmware kept restarting and the logger went back to the previous one
note: Check the version published with manage.py publish-fw before offering it again

name: Phase current near the PLN limit
condition: highest 15 s phase current above 90 % of the PLN limit for 5 min
note: The PLN limiter trips on one overloaded phase even when the total kVA is under contract: 82.5 kVA = 3 x 125 A at 220 V (contracted_kva, contract_v_ln in site.json)
